name: Decor Helper
description: Decoration tips and one-click auto shadows in the editor.

show-tip.name: Show Tip In Popup
show-tip.description: Show a random decoration tip when opening the Decor popup.

offset-x.name: Shadow Offset X
offset-x.description: How far the shadow copy is moved horizontally (in units).

offset-y.name: Shadow Offset Y
offset-y.description: How far the shadow copy is moved vertically (in units).

shadow-color.name: Shadow Color Channel
shadow-color.description: Color channel for the shadow copy. 1010 = Black.
